column1: 1.2.1|能力选择|确定性与可重复执行|Deterministic execution|规则系统把明确条件映射到动作。同一输入和规则版本应产生同一结果，适合固定阈值、必填校验和明确审批政策。|Rules map explicit conditions to actions and should give repeatable results for the same input and rule version.|报销超过5000元必须审批，用金额规则执行。|Apply an explicit approval rule above 5,000.|不是所有自动化都需要学习模型。|Not every automation requires a learned model.|ml

1.2.1|能力选择|预测、生成与行动的边界|Prediction, generation and action|预测估计未知结果；生成产生新内容；代理协调工具和步骤执行目标。一个业务系统可以组合三者，应分别验收预测误差、内容质量和行动权限。|Prediction estimates outcomes, generation produces content, and an agent coordinates actions. Evaluate their errors, content and authority separately.|预测缺货后起草补货建议，实际下单仍需授权。|Forecast shortages, draft a recommendation, then authorize any order.|能写出行动建议，不等于已被允许执行。|A recommendation is not authorization to act.|ml

1.2.2|代理控制|自主性与停止条件|Autonomy and stop conditions|代理的自主性是无需逐步人工指令即可选择行动的程度。应明确目标、可用工具、次数或金额限制、停止条件和异常升级，而不是把自主性理解为无限权限。|Autonomy is the scope of independent action; constrain goals, tools, budgets, stopping conditions and escalation.|连续两次检索失败后停止，转给人工核对。|Stop after two failed retrieval attempts and escalate.|自主性越高，监督和边界越不能省略。|Greater autonomy increases the need for boundaries.|agent

1.2.2|代理控制|工具契约与最小行动权限|Tool contracts and action permissions|工具调用需要约定输入、输出、错误、授权和副作用。退款、发邮件等改变外部状态的工具，应在服务端检查权限并保存审计记录。|Tool contracts define inputs, outputs, errors, authorization and side effects; enforce permissions outside the model.|退款工具拒绝超过额度的请求，并记录调用者。|A refund service rejects requests above its limit and logs callers.|提示词中的提醒不能替代服务端权限检查。|A prompt cannot replace service-side authorization.|agent

1.2.2|代理协作|交接与编排|Handoffs and orchestration|多代理编排规定谁做什么、传什么证据以及何时交接。串行流程适合依赖关系，受控并行可处理独立任务；交接应保留来源、状态和失败责任。|Orchestration assigns roles, dependencies and evidence-preserving handoffs; parallelize only independent work.|检索角色交付带出处的资料，审核角色核对后交给起草者。|Retrieval hands sourced evidence to a reviewer before drafting.|增加角色数量本身不是质量证据。|More roles alone do not establish quality.|agent

1.2.3|运行监测|数据漂移与概念漂移|Data drift and concept drift|数据漂移是输入分布变化；概念漂移是输入与目标关系变化。发现分布变化不等于已经证明业务损害，需要结合真实结果和任务指标调查。|Data drift changes input distributions; concept drift changes input-to-target relationships. Investigate performance and business impact.|新客户用词变了是输入变化，促销使同一价格对应的需求改变是关系变化。|New customer language changes inputs; a promotion can change price-demand relationships.|不能看到漂移告警就不加验证地自动重训上线。|A drift alert is not sufficient grounds for automatic release.|monitor

1.2.3|运行监测|监测基线与反馈闭环|Monitoring baselines and feedback|上线前记录可比较的质量、延迟、成本和失败率。运行时监测变化，调查原因，验证修复，再决定重训、回退或调整用途。|Record quality, latency, cost and failure baselines, then monitor, investigate, validate fixes and decide deployment action.|投诉分类准确率下降时，抽查新样本并比较旧版模型。|Inspect new examples and compare model versions after classification degrades.|一次上线验收不能替代持续监测。|Acceptance testing does not replace ongoing monitoring.|monitor

1.2.4|工具治理|工具分级与影子AI|Tool classification and shadow AI|把工具标为已批准、受限、评估中或禁止，同时说明适用数据和用途。影子AI是未经组织批准或管理的使用，应提供可用替代、培训和反馈渠道。|Classify tools and permitted data uses; reduce unmanaged AI use with workable approved alternatives and guidance.|公开可用工具清单，并提供敏感文档的合规处理渠道。|Publish allowed tools and a supported route for sensitive documents.|只列禁用名单而不解决工作需求，难以形成可执行治理。|A ban list alone does not resolve employees' needs.|govern

1.3.1|提示设计|任务、上下文、约束与格式|Task, context, constraints and format|提示应交代要做的工作、相关资料、不可越过的边界及期望输出。把原始资料与操作指令分隔，能减少模型把文档文字误当指令的机会。|Specify the task, relevant context, boundaries and output format; separate source content from instructions.|依据访谈提取三项需求，逐项引用，未出现的内容写未知。|Extract three needs with citations and mark unsupported details unknown.|更长的提示不必然更好，必须验证输出是否满足任务。|Length alone does not establish prompt quality.|prompt

1.3.1|提示验证|代表性样例与提示版本|Representative tests and prompt versions|用典型、边界和失败案例测试提示，记录版本和成功标准。少样本示例应展示期望任务模式，而不是把测试题答案泄漏给模型。|Test typical, edge and failure cases and version prompts against explicit success criteria.|同时测试普通工单、缺失资料工单与无权访问工单。|Test normal tickets, missing evidence and unauthorized requests.|单次漂亮回答不能证明提示可稳定复用。|One impressive answer does not show reliability.|prompt

1.3.2|上下文规划|输入与输出共享预算|Shared input and output budget|上下文窗口有限。规划时需计入指令、检索片段、历史对话、工具消息和预留输出，超过限制时应筛选、压缩或拆分。|Budget instructions, retrieved material, conversation, tool messages and reserved output within the context limit.|窗口8000，指令1000、资料5000、历史1000，输出1500会超过500。|An 8,000-token window cannot fit 7,000 input tokens plus 1,500 output tokens.|词元不等于中文字数，实际计数依模型分词器。|Tokens are not identical to characters; use the model tokenizer.|context

1.3.2|上下文规划|相关性与信息位置|Relevance and information selection|资料能放入窗口不代表所有内容都会被正确使用。优先提供当前问题相关、获授权且版本明确的片段，并验证回答是否真正引用了支持结论的内容。|Fitting within the window does not ensure correct use; select relevant authorized evidence and verify support.|只取当前退款政策相关段落，而不是拼进所有部门手册。|Retrieve the refund policy instead of every department manual.|上下文容量不是事实准确率的保证。|Context capacity does not guarantee factual accuracy.|context

1.3.3|适配技术|RAG的检索与生成两道关|Retrieval and generation checks|RAG先检索资料，再把相关片段提供给模型生成。分别评估是否找对资料，以及回答是否被资料支持；同时维护版本、权限和缺失证据时的处理。|Evaluate retrieval relevance separately from answer grounding, with source versions and permissions enforced.|政策更新后重建索引，并测试旧版本是否仍被错误引用。|Refresh policy indexes and test whether obsolete versions are still cited.|有引用不等于引用支持结论。|A citation may fail to support a claim.|rag

1.3.3|适配技术|微调与外部知识更新|Fine-tuning versus external updates|微调通过训练调整参数，适合评估任务行为、格式或风格适配；外部资料频繁更新时，通常先评估检索和资料维护需求。两者可组合，但不能相互冒充。|Fine-tuning adjusts parameters for behavior or task adaptation; frequently changing facts also need source maintenance and retrieval.|统一客服回复风格可评估微调，今天更新的退货政策需要及时资料。|Style adaptation and today's policy update are different requirements.|不要把微调当成随时更新的事实数据库。|Fine-tuning is not a live factual database.|rag

2.1.1|用例设计|问题、受益者与可观测结果|Problem, beneficiary and outcome|用例要说明谁在什么流程遇到什么问题、现有基线是什么、预期改变如何测量，再选择合适能力。跨职能用例的成功标准会不同。|State the affected workflow, beneficiaries, baseline and measurable outcome before selecting AI capabilities.|客服看处理质量，销售看合格线索，研发看验证周期，开发看评审后交付质量。|Support, sales, research and software teams require different outcome measures.|工具名称不是业务问题。|A tool name is not a business problem.|strategy

2.1.2|实施路径|自建、购买与合作的比较维度|Build, buy and partner criteria|比较时间、预算、差异化需求、内部能力、集成、持续运营、供应商条款和退出成本。已有产品适配且交付期紧时，购买可能比自建更可行。|Compare delivery time, capability, differentiation, integration, operating support, supplier terms and exit costs.|缺少运维团队且三个月要上线，先核对现成服务的能力与约束。|With no operations team and a short deadline, evaluate a managed service's fit.|购买服务不免除本企业的数据和用途责任。|Buying a service does not transfer all use-case responsibilities.|strategy

2.1.3|项目组合|价值、可行性与硬性约束|Value, feasibility and hard constraints|先识别必须满足的数据授权、安全和业务连续性条件，再比较价值、实施能力与战略契合度。高预期收益不能抵消尚未满足的硬约束。|Check mandatory permissions and operational constraints before ranking value, feasibility and strategic fit.|收益最高的项目没有合法可用资料，应先暂停补齐条件。|Pause a high-return project when usable authorized data is unavailable.|评分模型用于辅助讨论，权重与门槛应明确。|Make scoring assumptions and mandatory gates explicit.|strategy

2.1.4|替代方案|不使用AI也是方案|Non-AI alternatives|若明确规则、检索或流程改进已解决问题，应把它们纳入比较。也应停止不具备可验证收益、可用数据或可接受风险边界的AI方案。|Compare rules, search and process redesign with AI; stop initiatives lacking feasible evidence or acceptable controls.|文件命名混乱先完善归档，而不是默认训练模型。|Fix document organization before assuming model training is needed.|暂停或终止是有效的项目决策。|Pausing or ending a project can be appropriate.|strategy

2.1.5|迁移方案|切换、回退与业务连续性|Cutover, rollback and continuity|迁移前验证新旧系统表现、接口、数据准备和成本，明确切换窗口、责任人、回退触发及恢复方式；迁移成功不能只看系统已启动。|Validate performance, interfaces, data and costs and define cutover owners, rollback triggers and recovery.|先在部分请求上验证新平台，异常时可回到原处理流程。|Validate on a limited traffic share with a functioning fallback.|回退方案也需要演练与可用资源。|A fallback must be tested and resourced.|operations

2.2.1|价值度量|结果指标与活动指标|Outcome and activity measures|活动指标记录做了多少，如开通账号；结果指标记录业务改变，如差错率、处理周期、转化率。效率必须与质量和复核代价一起看。|Activity measures track use; outcome measures track changed results. Evaluate speed alongside quality and review effort.|账号增长但处理错误增加，不能仅凭采用率宣布成功。|Higher adoption with more errors is insufficient evidence of success.|单一速度指标容易掩盖质量损失。|Speed alone can hide quality losses.|value

2.2.1|价值度量|有形收益与无形收益|Tangible and intangible benefits|有形收益可以形成可核验的金额或运营变化；满意度、信任等无形收益应设计独立测量，不能任意折算成已经实现的现金。|Measure financial and operational effects separately from experience or trust; justify any monetary conversion.|分别报告已兑现成本减少与客户满意度变化。|Report realized cost reductions and satisfaction changes separately.|无形收益不是无需证据的收益。|Intangible benefits still require evidence.|value

2.2.2|对照设计|可比较基线与归因|Comparable baselines and attribution|记录实施前同口径指标，并尽量控制任务难度、业务量和时间因素。对照组或分阶段试验有助于区分AI效果与同期其他改变。|Use consistent definitions and comparable workloads; controls or staged tests help distinguish AI effects from other changes.|相同类型工单比较总处理时间，包括人工复核。|Compare similar tickets using total handling time including review.|上线前后数字不同，不自动证明因果关系。|A before-and-after difference alone does not prove causation.|value

2.2.3|财务核算|ROI公式与核算边界|ROI and accounting boundaries|简单ROI等于同期收益减同期完整成本，再除以同期完整成本。明确期间、单位、收益实现条件和成本范围，才能比较不同方案。|Simple ROI is net benefit divided by total cost over a consistent period; define units, scope and realization assumptions.|收益150万元、完整成本100万元，ROI为50%。|Benefits of 150 and total costs of 100 yield a 50% ROI.|不能用净收益除以收益冒充ROI。|Net benefit divided by benefits is not this ROI definition.|finance

2.2.3|财务核算|释放产能与现金节省|Released capacity and cash savings|节省工时可释放产能，但只有支出实际减少才构成现金成本节省。若把产能用于新增产出，还需证明需求、人员安排和新增收入能够实现。|Freed time is capacity; cash savings require actual expenditure reduction. Additional output needs realization evidence.|每周省十小时但工资未减少，先记为可用产能。|Ten freed hours with unchanged payroll are released capacity.|同一批省时不能无依据地重复计入减员与新增收益。|Do not double-count the same time saving.|finance

2.2.4|收益跟踪|先导信号与滞后结果|Leading and lagging indicators|培训完成、使用频率等可作为早期信号；留存、服务质量、净收益等结果需要后续观察。应说明预期联系，并检验先导指标能否预测结果。|Training and usage can signal progress, but later quality and value outcomes must validate their usefulness.|培训后继续追踪独立核验正确率，而不只统计出勤。|Track verification performance after training, not attendance alone.|先导指标向好不等于收益已兑现。|Positive leading indicators are not realized benefits.|value

2.2.5|成本控制|全生命周期成本|Lifecycle cost|预算包括数据整理、集成、部署、调用或计算、培训、人工复核、监测、维护和退出迁移。按业务量变化分析单位成本和总成本。|Include data, integration, deployment, usage, training, review, monitoring, maintenance and exit costs.|减少模型调用费却增加大量人工复核，可能没有降低完整成本。|Cheaper inference may not lower total cost if review effort rises.|单次调用价格不能代表系统总成本。|Per-call price is not total system cost.|finance

2.3.1|竞争判断|客户问题与竞争位置|Customer need and competitive position|分析竞争变化如何影响客户期待、交付效率和价值链，再决定投资方向。相同工具在不同业务条件下可能产生不同价值。|Examine customer expectations, delivery and value-chain effects rather than copying a competitor's tool choice.|同行推出智能客服，本企业先核对客户最常见的服务障碍。|Investigate service barriers before copying a competitor's chatbot.|竞争对手的投入金额不是本企业的投资依据。|A competitor's budget is not your business case.|strategy

2.3.2|价值创造|价值主张、交付与收益逻辑|Value proposition, delivery and revenue|业务模式变化涉及提供何种客户价值、如何交付以及如何获得收益。给现有产品贴AI标签不等于重构业务模式。|A business model links customer value, delivery and revenue; an AI label alone changes none of these.|按项目交付咨询转为持续监测服务，需要重新评估定价和运营责任。|Moving from projects to ongoing monitoring changes pricing and operations.|新的技术能力必须连接具体付费或价值实现方式。|Connect capabilities to a concrete value-realization mechanism.|strategy

2.3.3|持续优势|互补能力与学习闭环|Complementary capabilities and learning|可持续优势常来自获授权的数据、嵌入流程、领域经验、客户关系和持续反馈的组合，而不是人人都能购买的同一基础模型。|Differentiation can come from authorized data, workflows, expertise and feedback rather than a commodity model alone.|积累经核验的维修反馈，并把它用于改进服务流程。|Use verified maintenance feedback to improve service workflows.|数据多不等于数据独有、可用或有权使用。|More data does not establish exclusivity or permission.|strategy

2.3.4|投资节奏|分阶段承诺与停止条件|Staged commitments and stop conditions|结合行业条件和自身准备度，先验证关键假设，再逐步扩大投入。预先定义价值、质量、风险和成本不达标时的暂停或退出条件。|Stage investment around tested assumptions and define value, quality, risk and cost stop conditions.|先验证获客质量，再决定是否扩展生成内容预算。|Validate lead quality before expanding a content-generation budget.|试点投入已发生不是继续投入的充分理由。|Sunk pilot costs alone do not justify more investment.|value

3.1.1|责任原则|公平性与分组表现|Fairness and subgroup outcomes|公平性评估要结合具体用途和受影响群体，检查差错、机会和影响的差异。总体平均指标不能替代相关群体评估，目标之间也可能存在取舍。|Assess relevant groups and impacts for the use case; overall averages cannot substitute for subgroup evaluation.|总体错误率低，但某地区用户频繁受损，需要单独调查。|Investigate a region with disproportionately harmful errors.|不存在脱离用途、适用于一切情境的单一公平指标。|No single fairness metric fits every context.|trust

3.1.1|责任原则|可说明性与透明度|Explainability and transparency|可说明性帮助理解系统行为或判断依据；透明度使相关人员了解AI参与、适用边界和重要限制，以便作出知情选择。|Explainability supports understanding behavior; transparency supports informed choices about AI use and its limits.|告知客户使用AI，并提供可理解的判断依据和申诉渠道。|Disclose AI use and provide understandable grounds and recourse.|展示技术术语不等于给出可用解释。|Technical jargon is not necessarily a useful explanation.|trust

3.1.1|责任原则|隐私、安全与稳健性|Privacy, security and robustness|隐私关注个人资料的适当使用与保护；安全关注防止未授权访问或破坏；稳健性关注系统在合理变化和异常条件下仍能适当运行。|Privacy concerns appropriate personal-data use; security concerns unauthorized access or harm; robustness concerns behavior under changing conditions.|检查访问权限，限制敏感数据，并测试异常输入。|Enforce access, limit sensitive data and test abnormal inputs.|这些维度相关但不能互相替代。|These dimensions overlap but do not replace one another.|trust

3.1.2|责任取舍|收益、影响与比例原则|Benefits, impacts and proportionate controls|讨论效率收益时同时说明受影响对象、损害可能性、严重程度和可逆性。选择与影响相称的控制，并记录取舍和决定责任。|Assess affected parties, likelihood, severity and reversibility when balancing benefits and controls.|高影响决定保留有效人工复核，而非只追求自动处理率。|Retain meaningful human review for high-impact decisions.|业务指标提高不能自动抵消对个人的严重损害。|Business improvement does not automatically offset serious harm.|risk

3.1.3|设计时治理|从用途定义开始设置保障|Safeguards from use-case definition|在选择数据、设计功能和定义验收标准时纳入责任要求，识别不允许的用途和需要人工介入的情形，再迭代验证。|Define permitted uses, safeguards and review conditions during data and feature design, then test them.|设计客服检索时就实施权限，而不是上线后只加免责声明。|Implement retrieval permissions during design, not just a later notice.|设计时治理不意味着不允许小范围迭代。|Governance by design can coexist with controlled iteration.|responsible

3.1.4|人工监督|复核能力与升级阈值|Review capability and escalation triggers|监督者需要证据、时间、训练和停止或修改行动的权限。为无来源结论、异常指标和高影响操作定义升级条件与接手者。|Reviewers need evidence, time, training and authority; define escalation triggers and owners.|不能核验的重要结论转给负责人，不能只要求点击确认。|Escalate an important unsupported result rather than requesting ceremonial approval.|有人工按钮不代表已经形成有效监督。|A human button alone is not meaningful oversight.|risk

3.2.1|治理角色|负责执行与最终问责|Responsible versus accountable|执行者完成工作，最终问责者对决定和结果负责。业务、技术、数据和监督职能需要明确协作与授权边界，避免多人参与却无人作决定。|Distinguish doing the work from owning a decision; define cross-functional authority and handoffs.|业务负责人批准用途，数据负责人维护资料，运维负责告警。|Business approves use, data owners maintain sources, and operations handle alerts.|供应商负责模型服务，不等于替客户承担全部业务决定。|A supplier does not own all customer use decisions.|govern

3.2.2|合规识别|用途、资料与适用要求|Use, data and applicable requirements|合规识别需要知道系统用途、受影响人群、数据类别、使用地区及组织要求，再由有责任的专业人员核对适用条件。|Assess intended use, people, data, location and organizational requirements with responsible specialists.|内部文稿辅助改为影响客户权益的自动决定，需要重新评估。|Reassess when a drafting aid becomes a consequential decision system.|通用清单不能替代针对具体用途的判断。|A generic checklist is not a use-specific determination.|govern

3.2.3|权限实施|最小权限与检索前过滤|Least privilege and pre-retrieval filtering|只授予工作所需的数据与工具权限，在检索或执行前验证身份和授权。输出后再遮盖，不能代替阻止越权检索。|Authorize identities and data or tools before retrieval and execution; grant only needed access.|客服可读获准政策，不能读人事档案，也不能自行批准高额退款。|Support may read policy but not personnel records or approve large refunds.|提示层拒绝不构成可靠权限边界。|A model refusal is not a reliable access boundary.|data

3.2.4|风险分级|按影响分配治理力度|Risk-proportionate governance|以用途、受影响对象、潜在损害和控制情况确定评估优先级，生命周期中用途或环境改变时重新分级。模型规模不是唯一风险标准。|Prioritize by use, affected people, harm and controls, and reassess when conditions change.|内部摘要与自动影响个人权益的决策需要不同审查力度。|Internal summaries and consequential decisions need different scrutiny.|风险分级不是一次立项表格。|Risk classification is not a one-time form.|risk

3.3.1|事件处置|检测、限制、调查与恢复|Detection, containment, investigation and recovery|记录模型版本、输入、输出和告警以便追踪；出现异常时先控制影响，再调查、修复和验证，满足恢复条件后再扩大使用。|Log relevant versions and events, contain impact, investigate and validate remediation before restoring use.|投诉激增时暂停自动发送，保留辅助起草并安排人工审核。|Pause automatic sending while investigating an error spike.|事故演练顺序服务于具体条件，不是所有组织的唯一流程。|An exercise sequence is not a universal incident procedure.|operations

3.3.2|偏差管理|采样、标注、目标与部署|Sampling, labels, objectives and deployment|偏差可能源自缺乏代表性的样本、不一致标注、优化目标和部署人群差异。对相关群体持续监测，并调查差异的原因。|Bias can originate in sampling, labeling, objectives and deployment populations; investigate subgroup differences over time.|新地区加入后，检查当地表达方式是否被原数据覆盖。|Check whether new regional language is represented in the data.|仅扩大样本量不保证消除偏差。|Larger datasets do not automatically remove bias.|trust

3.3.3|内容与权利|来源授权、输出用途与有害内容|Source rights, output uses and harmful content|核对输入资料允许的使用方式，并根据输出用途设置内容审核、投诉和处置流程。来源有授权不等于输出一定安全，过滤有害内容也不能证明已获版权许可。|Review source permissions and output use and operate content review and remediation; rights and harmful-content controls are distinct.|公开发布前同时检查素材使用条件和输出风险。|Review both use rights and harmful content before publication.|模型生成不自动意味着无权利限制。|Generated material is not automatically unrestricted.|risk

3.3.4|可靠性|证据支持与不确定性|Evidence support and uncertainty|幻觉是看似可信却错误或无依据的内容。核对资料相关性、引用支持和版本，对重要未知保留不确定性并升级复核。|Check relevance, support and source versions; communicate uncertainty and escalate important unknowns.|回答引用存在，但引用没有包含声称的退款期限。|A citation exists but does not support the claimed refund deadline.|检索、引用或人工复核都不是零错误保证。|Retrieval, citations and review are not zero-error guarantees.|rag

4.1.1|准备度维度|领导、数据、文化、技术与治理|Leadership, data, culture, technology and governance|准备度是能否开展并维持特定用途的条件。分别检查领导共识、数据可用性、文化与技能、基础设施和治理，记录证据而非只填写自评分。|Assess use-specific readiness across leadership, data, culture, skills, infrastructure and governance using evidence.|有预算和演示，但没有资料负责人，数据准备仍有缺口。|A funded demo without data owners still has a readiness gap.|准备度会随用途改变，不能只给全企业一个分数。|Readiness varies by use case, not just by company.|maturity

4.1.2|成熟度评估|探索、实验与可持续运营|Exploration, experiments and sustainable operations|成熟度关注能力是否可重复、可治理并能持续运营。一次试点成功与多团队稳定使用不同；具体阶段模型应说明定义和证据要求。|Maturity concerns repeatable, governed operations; a successful pilot differs from sustained multi-team capability.|多个演示都依靠同一人手动修复，不代表已具备规模化能力。|Many demos depending on one expert do not establish scalable operations.|成熟度模型是诊断工具，不是准确率认证。|A maturity model is a diagnostic tool, not an accuracy certificate.|maturity

4.1.3|能力诊断|区分技能、流程、技术与权限缺口|Distinguishing capability gaps|推广受阻可能因为不会操作、流程未改、系统不可用或没有授权。先确定具体阻碍，再安排对应干预，避免所有问题都用采购或培训解决。|Diagnose whether a gap concerns skills, workflow, technology or authority before selecting an intervention.|员工知道如何核验，但无权查看原文，应解决访问与流程问题。|A trained reviewer lacking source access needs permissions, not just more training.|相同的低采用率可能有不同原因。|The same low adoption measure can have different causes.|maturity

4.1.4|投资路线|依赖关系与阶段成果|Dependencies and staged outcomes|把战略目标拆成可核验的阶段成果，识别前置依赖和责任人，优先补齐阻碍价值实现的关键条件，再验证下一步投入。|Build evidence-based milestones with dependencies and owners and address bottlenecks before expanding investment.|先统一资料责任和质量标准，再扩大使用团队。|Establish data ownership and quality standards before expansion.|不能按“容易展示”替代战略与依赖分析。|Demo appeal is not a substitute for dependency analysis.|maturity

4.2.1|数据准备|质量维度与数据契约|Quality dimensions and data contracts|针对用途检查准确、完整、一致、及时和相关性，约定字段意义、主键、格式及缺失值处理。数据孤岛还会带来重复和不同口径。|Assess fitness for use and define field meanings, keys, formats and missing-value handling across sources.|同一客户有两条订单副本，先查主键与来源而不是直接相加。|Investigate duplicate order keys before summing totals.|格式统一不等于数值真实，清洗需要保留依据。|Consistent formatting does not establish factual correctness.|data

4.2.2|数据治理|所有者、血缘与版本|Owners, lineage and versions|资料需要明确维护责任、来源去向、版本和共享边界，以便核验答案、修复错误并追踪变化。共享应保留权限而不是复制后全面公开。|Track accountable owners, lineage, versions and sharing boundaries for maintainable and verifiable information.|制度更新后能查到负责部门、有效日期与旧版去向。|Track policy ownership, effective dates and superseded versions.|能访问数据不等于可以任意再利用。|Access does not imply unrestricted reuse.|data

4.2.3|基础设施|延迟、容量、可用性与运营|Latency, capacity, availability and operations|基础设施需服务实际工作负载，包括并发、数据存储、网络、模型调用、监测和故障恢复；评估成本、可扩展性与支持责任。|Assess workload concurrency, storage, networks, inference, monitoring and recovery together with cost and ownership.|客服系统除了生成质量，还要验证高峰响应和服务故障时的接手方式。|Test peak support traffic and fallback behavior as well as response quality.|购买更大算力不能替代数据与运营准备。|More compute does not replace data or operating readiness.|operations

4.3.1|变革支持|赞助者与业务倡导者|Sponsors and business champions|高层赞助者提供方向、资源和跨部门协调；业务倡导者帮助发现实际需求、示范使用和反馈。两者都需要明确权责，不能只有口号。|Sponsors provide direction and resources; champions connect practical needs, demonstrations and feedback within clear authority.|业务赞助者解决部门间资源冲突，倡导者组织岗位试用。|A sponsor resolves resource conflicts while champions organize role-specific trials.|热情志愿者不能替代正式的资源与责任安排。|Enthusiastic volunteers cannot replace formal ownership.|people

4.3.2|跨职能协作|业务、技术与监督角色|Business, technical and oversight roles|团队需具备需求判断、数据维护、技术实现、风险审查和运营能力，明确交付标准、接手关系和谁能暂停不适当用途。|Combine requirements, data, implementation, oversight and operations with explicit deliverables and stop authority.|上线审批中明确业务目标验收者和运行支持接手者。|Name business acceptance and operational handover owners.|团队名单齐全不代表决策机制清晰。|A complete roster does not guarantee clear decisions.|people

4.3.3|沟通设计|事实、未知、岗位影响与反馈|Facts, uncertainty, role impacts and feedback|沟通实施时间、已验证与尚未验证的结果、工作变化和支持措施，并建立双向反馈。不应为推动采用而许诺未经证实的岗位或收益结果。|Explain timing, verified results, uncertainty, role changes and support with two-way feedback.|说明哪些任务会被辅助，哪些决定仍由人承担。|Explain which tasks are assisted and which decisions remain human-owned.|只宣传收益而回避员工担忧会损害信任。|Ignoring employee concerns can undermine trust.|people

4.3.4|文化与激励|安全试验与问题反馈|Safe experimentation and issue reporting|当员工担心犯错受罚时，建立限定范围的安全练习、报告渠道和改进机制。区分抵触改变、合理风险担忧和工具不适配。|Use bounded practice and issue reporting and distinguish resistance from justified risk concerns or poor fit.|让员工在测试材料上练习核验，报告失败不扣采用率。|Practice verification on test material without penalizing issue reporting.|强制使用或更换工具不一定解决文化障碍。|Mandates or replacement tools may not resolve cultural barriers.|people

4.3.5|岗位培养|从会操作到能判断|From tool operation to judgment|按岗位设计真实任务，练习核验、边界识别、升级与人机交接，并以实际表现评估。POC和黑客马拉松也需要责任与验证目标。|Train role-specific verification, boundaries, escalation and handoffs and assess demonstrated performance.|客服训练核对政策和升级投诉，开发者训练代码评审与测试。|Support verifies policies; developers practice review and testing.|签到或通过工具介绍不能证明岗位胜任。|Attendance does not establish role competence.|people

4.3.6|人机分工|判断、同理心与责任|Judgment, empathy and responsibility|把可重复的辅助工作与需要语境、价值取舍和授权的判断分开，重新设计人的监督、沟通和创造性职责，明确最终责任。|Separate repeatable assistance from contextual judgment and authority and redesign oversight, communication and creative work.|AI起草投诉回复，人类理解处境、核验事实并决定发送。|AI drafts a complaint reply; a person verifies and authorizes it.|自动化一个任务不等于可以移交整个岗位责任。|Automating a task does not transfer all role accountability.|people

4.4.1|阶段转型|构想、实验、启动与扩展|Envision, experiment, launch and scale|构想明确问题与假设；实验验证可行性和价值；启动落实生产与治理；扩展验证更多团队和规模条件。反馈可使团队返回前一阶段。|Define assumptions, validate feasibility and value, establish production readiness and then test expansion conditions.|实验发现资料不可用时，返回补齐基础而不是强行上线。|Return to foundations when a pilot reveals unusable data.|阶段不是不可回头的固定流水线。|Stages do not prohibit iteration or returning to earlier work.|journey

4.4.2|推广策略|试点代表性与迁移条件|Pilot representativeness and transfer conditions|试点结果受参与者、数据和支持条件影响。扩展前检查新部门任务差异、资源、成本与用户能力，分批验证并保留暂停点。|Check how pilot users, data and support differ from new teams and validate expansion in batches.|志愿者团队表现好，新部门资料缺失时先暂停该部门推广。|Pause a new department with missing data despite a successful volunteer pilot.|把试点配置复制过去不等于验证了可迁移性。|Copying a pilot configuration does not validate transferability.|journey

4.4.3|共享能力|COE与业务责任|CoE and business accountability|卓越中心提供共享评估、标准、平台和经验复用，支持业务团队而不是代替它们定义价值或承担全部用例责任。|A CoE shares evaluation, standards, platforms and reusable practices while business teams retain use-case ownership.|多个团队共享检索评估方法，各自负责本部门知识有效性。|Teams reuse retrieval evaluation while owning their own source validity.|集中所有业务决策可能形成瓶颈。|Centralizing every business decision can create bottlenecks.|platform

4.4.4|持续价值|采用、质量、风险、成本与结果|Adoption, quality, risk, cost and outcomes|推广后的反馈同时观察使用、结果、风险与成本，区分短期热度和持续价值，用问题报告推动下一轮改进。|Track adoption, outcomes, risks and costs after rollout and use feedback to adapt the next iteration.|使用率提高而复核成本激增时，重新评估流程和净收益。|Reassess a workflow when adoption rises but review costs surge.|成功案例集合不能替代完整运行数据。|Success stories are not a substitute for operational evidence.|operations

4.4.6|企业扩展|性能、连续性、培训与支持|Performance, continuity, training and support|扩大业务量和团队范围时，重新验证峰值容量、延迟、资料权限、培训覆盖、支持成本与业务连续性，按证据调整节奏。|Revalidate capacity, latency, permissions, training, support costs and continuity as teams and workload expand.|新增地区前先确认本地资料、权限和支持接手。|Confirm regional data, permissions and support before adding locations.|规模扩大时原有质量与成本假设可能失效。|Quality and cost assumptions may change at scale.|platform
